title: Hawke Media Alternatives for Meta Video Ads and Startups
summary: Hawke Media alternatives for Meta video ads and startups, compared on scope, budget signals and fit, with done-for-you AI video from Knowlify as our top pick.
body_markdown:
## Which Hawke Media alternatives work for a startup?


Hawke Media's homepage describes clients of all sizes, but it does not describe a startup offer or a starting budget, so ask for both in writing. Several other agencies describe startup clients on their own sites. Taktical Digital says its clients range from lean startups to household brands, and that it creates a new set of ad assets each month, but it publishes no pricing or contract terms.[Taktical Digital](https://taktical.co/facebook-advertising-agency/)


Voy Media says its clients range from Fortune 500 companies to small startups, and that packages are based on total ad spend, optimizations and growth, with no figures published.[Voy Media](https://voymedia.com/pricing/) Ask it what a package would cost at your current spend before you compare it with a flat retainer.


NoGood works with startups and scaleups on monthly retainers, and it says its average retainer is above $20,000 a month. That is a large commitment for an early company, so choose it only if the budget already supports a growth team.[NoGood](https://nogood.io/paid-social-agency/)


If your startup sells B2B SaaS, Hey Digital works only with B2B SaaS companies and produces its creative in house. It asks for a three to six month commitment, and its own fit check says a one-month test is probably not a fit.[Hey Digital](https://www.heydigital.co/)


## What should you check in a Hawke Media alternative proposal?


Meta's engineering post on its Andromeda ad retrieval system says the number of ad creatives in its recommendation systems is expected to grow significantly as advertisers adopt generative AI tools.[Meta Andromeda](https://engineering.fb.com/2024/12/02/production-engineering/meta-andromeda-advantage-automation-next-gen-personalized-ads-retrieval-engine/) Ask each provider how many distinct concepts it will deliver each month, not how many files. A resized export of the same idea is not a new test.


Meta also says eligibility for its Business Partners program varies by solution type and is typically based on the quantity and quality of a company's work across Meta technologies. Treat a partner badge as one signal. Then ask who owns the ad account, who approves each cut and what happens when a concept stops working.[Meta Business Partners](https://www.facebook.com/business/marketing-partners)


If you are leaving Hawke Media, also ask for the finished video files and the ad account permissions in writing before notice starts, and ask any new provider to name which of your existing winning ads it would keep running.


## Where Hawke Media may still be the right supplier


You do not have to replace Hawke Media if it already runs connected TV, Amazon or SEO for you. The cleaner split is to keep that work with Hawke and buy Meta video creative separately. Knowlify's creative-only route fits that split when your own buyer or another media team runs the campaigns.


The split only works with shared rules. Agree on naming conventions, one test calendar and access to the same ad account. Otherwise two teams will test the same angle, and you will not know which creative worked.


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick when the gap is finished Meta video ads each week, with campaign management or creative only.
- Hawke Media covers paid social, search, connected TV, out-of-home and more, so replace only the channel that is missing.
- Darkroom and MuteSix cover Meta and Google together, but Darkroom's fit is poor under roughly $5M in revenue and MuteSix publishes no pricing.
- For a startup, confirm the starting budget first: NoGood's average retainer is above $20,000 a month.
- Before you sign, ask every provider for concepts per month, review rounds, usage rights and who owns the ad account.


## FAQ


### What is the best Hawke Media alternative for a startup?


Knowlify is our top pick for a startup that needs finished Meta video ads every week, with optional campaign management or creative only. For B2B SaaS, compare Hey Digital. For a lean team, ask Taktical Digital for a written scope, and judge each option on its monthly commitment and the number of concepts it delivers.


### Can Knowlify replace Hawke Media completely?


No. Knowlify's service is Meta video ads, so it does not cover connected TV, Amazon or SEO, and it does not supply real human creators. It fits the Meta video job, either as creative only for your buyer or with optional Meta campaign management.


### Do Hawke Media alternatives publish prices?


Several do not. Darkroom starts at $1,500 a month plus a percentage of media, and Chamber Media's minimum is about $5K to $10K a month. Hawke Media, MuteSix and Voy Media publish no figures, and Knowlify gives a custom quote. Compare proposals on the same scope rather than on a headline number.


### How should I compare a Hawke Media alternative?


Send one brief to each provider with the same deliverables: distinct concepts per month, review rounds, aspect ratios, usage rights, ad account ownership and who chooses what runs next. Score the written answers rather than the portfolio, since a portfolio shows what a company chose to show.
